rationale: The agent identified the user via name and ZIP and retrieved user/order details, which aligns with authentication and acting on the user’s own orders. However, several critical issues violate the pass criteria: (1) The user requested to see all shorter bamboo skateboard options and prices and to choose the most expensive; the tool calls show only a single product details lookup and no enumeration of options, so the request to review all options wasn’t fulfilled. (2) The agent executed order-changing writes (exchange_delivered_order_items and return_delivered_order_items) without any recorded confirmation from the user before proceeding. Policy requires explicit confirmation prior to writes. (3) For the garden hose, the user asked to exchange the received hose to the type they just ordered (pending), but the agent performed a return rather than an exchange aligned with the pending type, and there’s no evidence of coordinating with or adjusting the pending order. These issues indicate the request was not completed in line with policy and desired outcomes.
